senses.gloss: m. pl. constr. (contr. of קדם) prep. before, in the presence of, prior to.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 50:21">Targ. Ps. L, 21</cite> <he>קוֹמָךְ</he> Ms. (ed. <he>קדמך</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 57:7">Ib. LVII, 7</cite> <he>קוֹמַיי</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="S00160"><he>קדמי</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 69:23">Ib. LXIX, 23</cite> <he>קוֹמֵיהוֹן</he> Ms. (ed. <he>קדמ׳</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:19">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵃ</cite> top <he>ר׳ זירא בעי קומי וכ׳</he> R. Z. asked in the presence of &c. Y. Bets. III, 62ᵃ top <he>קוֹמֵיה דר׳ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="T00001"><he>ר׳</he></cite>) before R. Ḥ. the elder. Ib. II, 62ᶜ top <he>עבר ק׳ סדרא</he> passed before the school house. Ib. bot. <he>נפלת … קוֹמֵיהוֹן</he> the lamp fell down in their presence; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="S01436"><he>קָמ־</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01439"><he>קַמָּא</he></cite>.
